## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Approved issue

Link the issue where the implementation was discussed and approved, or explain why prior discussion was not required.

## Verification

List the exact automated tests and manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I have at most one implementation pull request open.
- [ ] A maintainer agreed to this implementation where prior discussion is required.
- [ ] I reviewed and understand the complete diff, including any AI-assisted work.
- [ ] Focused tests exercise the changed production path and fail without the fix.
- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] The pull request contains no unrelated changes or unresolved dependencies.
